content_html: Wasn’t Office Space set in Austin? And there’s no relation to the Innotech company? I don’t believe it!

It’s definitely a poor choice of name. “Innotech” v. “Innitech”

Office Space was filmed around the neighborhood of a previous employer of mine that was pure Dilbert fodder. Coincidence? — I think not.
The next Innotech conference should use a red stapler as the conference logo.
In Office Space, the company is actually Initech, and after the building burnes, Michael and the other guy go to work for Initrode.

Actually, many of the scenes in the movie “Office Space” were filmed in and around the DFW area. Las Colinas was the back drop for the seen when Peter, Samir and Michael are walking back from their coffee break at Chotchkie’s. The buildings seen behind them in this scene are along Hwy 114 looking east/north east. Also, the opening scene of the movie is filmed just west of the I-635 and Dallas North Tollway interchange, looking east.
